policy.mask_scope: delivery_only or all_motor; legacy absent scope means all_motor
policy.spatial_match: source geometry intersects excluded facility area or buffered sensitive POI

source_family: same frozen OpenStreetMap PBF as depot candidates
mask_storage: private build input; never package as public POI layer
coverage_limit: Excludes identifiable tags, names and OSM host areas. OSM incompleteness prevents a claim of exhaustive real-world detection.
